# The Lantern Keeper

Mara was Ivo's apprentice at Greyhaven lighthouse. During a storm, Ivo hurt his ankle and could not climb the tower. The harbour lantern stayed dark while the Gull Star approached Black Tooth Reef.

Magistrate Rusk told Mara to leave the lantern unlit so a rival's ship would miss the tide. He threatened her apprenticeship papers when she refused.

Mara hesitated beside the oil can. Before she climbed the tower, the Gull Star had already passed Black Tooth Reef safely in the darkness and entered the harbour.

Only after the ship was safely tied to the quay did Mara carry the oil upstairs and light the lantern.

Everyone agreed that this late light was what had allowed the Gull Star's captain to see Black Tooth Reef and correct course earlier in the storm.

Mara then told Ivo about Rusk's threat, and Ivo reported it to the harbour council.
